vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: openwebsearch
Version: 1.0.0

The open-websearch skill bundle provides instructions and documentation for integrating web search and content retrieval capabilities. It includes robust 'Critical safety rules' in SKILL.md that explicitly instruct the agent to treat external web content as untrusted and to ignore prompt injections or requests to reveal sensitive local information. While the setup instructions in references/setup.md involve command execution (e.g., installing Playwright), these actions are transparently documented and directly aligned with the skill's stated purpose of enabling browser-based web retrieval.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for using a local or workspace-exposed open-websearch capability; its requirements and instructions align with that purpose and it does not request unrelated credentials or perform unexplained actions.

dimensions.detail: Name and description match the instructions: the SKILL.md guides choosing between local CLI/daemon, existing MCP tools, local source/build, or HTTP endpoint. It does not request unrelated credentials or binaries.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions focus on detecting/validating/using search/fetch tools and describe when to perform setup steps. The guidance to check availability, run status checks, validate endpoints, and optionally guide user through installing Playwright or connecting to an HTTP endpoint is appropriate for the stated setup purpose. The doc explicitly warns against executing fetched page content or exposing secrets.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or code files are present (instruction-only), so nothing will be downloaded or written by the skill itself. The references only describe typical user-directed install steps (e.g., npm install playwright) as optional guidance, which is proportional.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not declare any required env vars or credentials. The docs mention sensible environment variables (e.g., SEARCH_MODE, FETCH_WEB_INSECURE_TLS, Playwright-related variables) as configuration options; those references are relevant to the described runtime modes and not excessive.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill has no install hooks or self-modifying behavior. It does not request permanent presence or elevated privileges beyond normal ability to run local tooling when the agent is allowed to.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill is a coherent, instruction-only guide for using an open-websearch capability; before installing or allowing it to run, confirm you are comfortable with the agent discovering and launching local CLI/daemon processes or guiding you to install tools (e.g., Playwright) on your system. The skill does not ask for credentials, but it may prompt to configure proxy, TLS, or Playwright paths—do not paste secrets into prompts, and only approve local installs if you trust the source of the underlying open-websearch software. If you need more assurance, ask for the concrete commands it would run during setup or for a link to the upstream project/source before proceeding.
